page.layout: Two printed pages on the scan. Left page: one column of Latin verse, stanzas numbered 19 to 28 at their left, ending with the catchword at the lower right. Right page: only its left edge is visible, with a running-head fragment and a column of short marginal entries, cut off by the scan edge.

main_text.p: 19 Bis senos Ephesi Baptizat, signaque multa Aedit, Sceuidas daemonis ira rapit. Infames rutilo conflagrant igne libelli: Hinc faber insidias disidiumque monet.
20 Discedens Epheso peruenit Troada Paulus. Decidis ex alto, somniculose, loco. Et Solymos repetens clara inter tecta Mileti Chara Epheso dicit, triftia verba, Vale.
21 Paulus multum errans contingit Caesaris urbem. Hic vates Pauli vincula dura canit. Verberatin Solymis hunc impia turba, tribunus Liberat, & vincit dupla catena virum.
22 Exponit Paulus qua fit ratione vocatus. Gentibus auditis impia turba furit. Dumque volunt vinctum prolatis cadere virgis, Romanum redimit patria terra virum.
23 Denuo productus Paulus se a crimine purgat. Iudicium turbant litibus inde nomis. Insidia Paulo devota mente struuntur. Caesaream multo milite tutus abit.
24 Intendit rursum Tertullus crimina falsa. Indesuam Paulus purgat vt ante fidem. Saepius hunc audit Felix praefectus auarus, Sperans a capto turpia lucra viro.
25 Rursus vt accusant appellat Caesara Paulus. Sed non certa satis crimina Festus habet. Aduenit ad Festum chara cum coniuge Agrippa, Festus ab hoc causas consiliumque petit.
26 Paulus agit CHRISTI conflanti pectore causam. Et repetit primi priftina facta status. Rex quoque deuicto tantum non pectore credit Et Paulum insontem praedicat esse virum.
27 Italiam versus Syrio de litore soluunt, Et Creta aduerso flamine regna tenent. Non parent Paulo, venti furiis aira procella. Mergitur insana naufraga puppis aqua.
28 In Melitem veniunt, prendit fera vipera dextram, Et multi, Paulo sic operante, valent. Delatus Romam Iudaeos conuocat omneis. Et verum sancto praedicat ore Deum.

page.notes: Verse numbers 19 to 28 stand at the left of each stanza; they are kept at the start of each stanza's paragraph. "disidium" (l. 19), "Verberatin" (l. 21), "Indesuam" (l. 24), "nomis" (l. 23), and "aira" (l. 27) are read from a small, slightly blurred scan and should be checked against the original. The right page is cut off at the scan edge: its running head and marginal entries are not legible enough to transcribe, so they are omitted. The catchword "ARGV:" is probably the start of the next argument.
